release_notes: Build 96 adds a Website Analytics page inside the Factburst desktop app. It uses the existing Link Tracker credentials and keeps analytics administration out of the public website.

Website Analytics supports 7, 30 and 90 day views with headline site views, quiz opens, completion rate and YouTube click-through rate, plus a full conversion funnel, per-quiz performance and traffic-source breakdowns.

The analytics feed remains aggregate-only. The desktop app reads daily event totals from the private authenticated go.factburstquiz.com admin Worker; it does not expose a public analytics dashboard or visitor-level records.
The quiz library now has quick category shortcuts and supports shareable category links such as quizzes.html?category=Space, while the standard category dropdown remains available.
Quiz results now add a More [category] action so players can continue with similar quizzes, and the Challenge a friend flow links directly to Profile when the player has no friends yet.
Build 95's duplicate Quiz History path repair and archive protections remain unchanged.
